reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 9.4 grants Customer an unqualified without-cause termination right over the Agreement and any Order Form, Section 29.4 fixes the notice at thirty days, and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period — matching the preferred position's 30-day notice plus pro-rata refund.
No early-termination fee or penalty is imposed (Customer owes only accrued Fees), so the walk-away and fallback fee-cap concerns are not engaged despite the three-year term in Section 8.1.

No Vendor termination-for-convenience right is identified; the rationale correctly notes Vendor's triggers are limited to breach/insolvency, satisfying the 'Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term' element.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the deterministic check confirms a Customer convenience right is present.
Rationale appropriately distinguishes Section 7.7 late-payment liquidated damages as a payment mechanic handled under a separate rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
